verdicts.rationale: Clean reproduction confirmed: POST /entities/insert with 101 records (ids 0-100) succeeded with HTTP 200 and insertCount=101. However, structured_contract.json contains NO constraints documenting a 100-record limit for insert operations. Source code analysis (handler_v2.go:1267) shows req.NumRows = uint32(len(httpReq.Data)) with no maximum limit check. Without documented constraint or reasonable physical limit (101 records is well within typical batch sizes), this cannot be considered a defect. The assertion appears to be based on an unstated expectation rather than documented contract violation. Matches mundane_api_semantics pattern.
